questionTextRaw: The pseudocode of a function                             is given below: fun(int A[0,....,n-1]) { for i=0 to n-2 for j=0 to n-i-2 if (A[j]>A[j+1]) then swap A[j] and A[j+1] } Let                     be an array storing distinct integers in descending order. The number of swap operations that will be performed, if the function                       is called with               as argument, is _________. (Answer in integer)
